stories.headline: China's AI chipmakers are raising prices as HBM stays scarce
opening: Huawei's advanced Ascend 950DT accelerator is being quoted above RMB 250,000, roughly 20–50% higher than two months ago. Cambricon has also lifted pricing on its upcoming 690 chip by 20–30%.
stories.myTake: AI compute is getting more expensive. That can eventually show up in the price of the tools and services people use every day.
stories.myTakeZh: AI 算力正在变贵，最后可能会反映到我们每天使用的 AI 工具和服务价格上。

stories.headline: Enflame heads to Shanghai with a $912m IPO
opening: Tencent-backed Enflame raised RMB 6.12bn and is set to debut on the STAR Market. It forecasts sharp revenue growth, while Tencent remains by far its biggest customer.
stories.myTake: Money is still pouring into the AI chip layer. The opportunity is real, but so is the risk when one customer matters too much.
stories.myTakeZh: 资本还在继续押注 AI 芯片，但客户太集中的风险也很真实。

stories.headline: The haze is back in the unhealthy range
opening: Central Singapore's 24-hour PSI reached 102 late Wednesday. Smoke from fires in Sumatra and Kalimantan continues to create a haze risk.
stories.myTake: This can change what you do today: exercise, dog walks and outdoor meals are all worth a quick PSI check.
stories.myTakeZh: 这会直接影响你今天怎么安排：运动、遛狗、户外吃饭前，都值得先看一眼 PSI。

stories.headline: Small-car COE hits a new record: S$133,009
opening: Category A COE rose to a record S$133,009. Category B also climbed to S$135,001.
stories.myTake: Even if you're not buying a car, this is a quick read on how expensive mobility has become in Singapore.
stories.myTakeZh: 就算你不买车，这也是理解新加坡出行成本到底有多高的一条新闻。
